answer_1.quote: To create models that can take a claim as input and generate a sequence of questions as output, we use sequence-to-sequence models... We use BART... The first step of QABRIEFER is to create the questions that will form the structure of the brief. ... The generated question and retrieved evidence document is provided to the question answering model to generate an answer.
answer_1.outputs: Fact‑checking briefs (QABriefs) consisting of generated questions and their answers

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the quality of question generation, following existing work, we use BLEU. To evaluate the quality of question answering, we use F1 score.

answer_4.quote: Crowdworkers on Mechanical Turk are presented with the 500 test set claims and instructed to use a search bar to decide if the claim is true, false, or in the middle... Volunteers are presented with 100 claims... Crowdworkers rated QABriefs helpful twice as often as Passage Briefs.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were asked to determine the claim's veracity, provide a justification of at least 20 words, and rate whether the brief made the fact‑check easier or provided useful background.
